answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 14 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in terrace, checked in jade, and relic shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3234 identities would post 2861 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
